title: A queue as a time window

steps.caption: Number of Recent Calls: count pings in the last 3000 ms. Times only increase, so old pings leave from the front: a queue.
ping(1): append it. Nothing expired. Answer 1.
ping(100): append it. Nothing expired. Answer 2.
ping(3001): append it. Nothing expired. Answer 3.
ping(3002): append it. Pop [1] from the front (older than 2). Answer 3.
ping(7000): append it. Pop [100, 3001, 3002] from the front (older than 4000). Answer 1.
